topic: Why urban trees matter — fictional practice material
summary: Trees can make a city more comfortable. This is original fictional sample material, not a transcript of a real video.

segments.title: 01 · A cooler street
segments.original: Trees provide shade on hot days. They also give birds a place to rest.
segments.translation: 나무는 더운 날 그늘을 제공합니다. 새들에게 쉴 곳도 제공합니다.
segments.grammar: provide + 명사: Trees provide shade. / a place to + 동사: a place to rest.

learner_original: Trees gives shade. I think city need more tree. They also...
teacher_notes: Fictional teacher note: check subject–verb agreement and plural nouns.

corrections.original: I think city need more tree.
corrections.corrected: I think cities need more trees.
corrections.reason: 여러 도시와 나무를 일반적으로 가리키는 예시입니다. 실제 의도에 따라 단수형도 가능합니다.
미완성 문장의 뜻을 임의로 채우지 않습니다.

grammar.rule: provide 다음에 제공하는 대상을 바로 씁니다.

grammar.example: Birds need a place to rest.

chunks: Birds need a place to rest.
I think cities need more trees.

exercises.question: 새들은 쉴 곳이 필요합니다.
exercises.answer: Birds need a place to rest.

questions: What did you mean by 'They also...'?
Were you describing one city or cities in general?
